items.title: Solana developers move to stop validators finishing work on blocks that already lost
items.summary: The fix would stop the computers that run Solana from wasting effort on transactions the network has already thrown out, freeing up power its recent speed upgrade didn't touch.

items.title: Sky lender proposes buyback of up to $50M to fund stUSDS withdrawals
items.summary: Borrowers would sell SKY to the protocol and use the proceeds to pay down their loans, freeing up funds for depositors in the stUSDS pool.

items.title: PHP2Shell Explained: What CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 Mean for Digital Asset Organizations
items.summary: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) is a critical PHP flaw under active attack. See how it puts digital asset keys at risk and how to patch it.

items.title: Gold's haven status has lost its edge over bitcoin, and the Fed's to blame
items.summary: Gold has lost the risk-adjusted advantage that made it this year's haven of choice over bitcoin. Both now offer negative one-year Sharpe ratios, leaving cash yields hard to beat.

items.title: A year after buying bitcoin, Czech central bank won't say what it's worth
items.summary: The Czech National Bank bought bitcoin a year ago as an experiment. The coin has fallen at least 40% since, and the bank's audited accounts carry it at cost rather than market value. The CNB told CoinDesk an outside custodian holds the coins.

items.title: Nvidia agrees to $290M settlement over crypto mining revenue disclosures
items.summary: The proposed settlement would resolve a shareholder lawsuit dating back to 2018 that alleged Nvidia misled investors about its exposure to the cryptocurrency industry.

items.title: French Senate rejects 100K euro crypto wallet disclosure requirement
items.summary: Senators also rejected stablecoin-swap and crypto exit-tax proposals, while the 2027 budget remains under parliamentary consideration.

items.title: Trump willing to pardon Jensen Huang, says it won’t be necessary
items.summary: The president’s remarks come days before Jensen Huang is due to face congressional questioning over national security concerns and US chip export controls.

items.title: CleanSpark weighs selling more Bitcoin than it mines to de-risk books
items.summary: The Bitcoin miner sold 2,102 BTC while it produced just 1,708 BTC in the September quarter.

items.title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price
items.summary: Bitcoin gave up gains above $60,000 as tariff concerns weighed on US stocks and Anthropic shares hit new lows below $76.

items.title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
items.summary: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum computing.

items.title: EU bank watchdog seeks European Commission rules for crypto firms offering DeFi lending
items.summary: The EBA renewed its call for the commission to propose rules for crypto firms granting client access to DeFi, particularly lending protocols.

items.title: Ukrainian lawmakers pass crypto tax and regulation bill expected to bring in $330 million
items.summary: Lawmaker Yaroslav Zhelezniak said he expects roughly $330 million (15 billion hryvnias) in added budget revenue, though the time frame remains unclear.

items.title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can’t keep ignoring Japan

items.title: South Korean crypto exchange Bithumb warns of phishing after deeper October breach probe
items.summary: South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange said its trading systems were not breached, but stolen customer records could already be being used in future scams.

items.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge lands with a December rate increase already priced in
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 25, 2026

items.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

items.title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
items.summary: UniCredit brings bitcoin investing to its roughly 8 million retail customers in Italy, offering them a six-year product that caps the redemption value but promises to return their capital.

items.title: EU proposes $54.7 billion fund for AI, quantum startups alongside post-quantum security push
items.summary: Brussels wants tech firms to grow at home. EU scale-ups raise about half the capital of San Francisco peers by year 10, an EIB study found.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs from lows as markets attempt midday bounce
items.summary: The Nasdaq narrowed an early 4.5% decline by about 50% as Michael Burry announced he's closed all tech shorts and gone long.
